"""One-shot migration for adapters/a01..a96: apply each file's TODO(migration) and drop the line."""
import pathlib
import re

ADAPTERS = pathlib.Path("adapters")
H = chr(35)  # "#"

TODO_BUMP = H + " TODO(migration): bump VERSION from 1 to 2"
TODO_TIMEOUT = re.compile(
    r'^' + H + r' TODO\(migration\): add a module constant TIMEOUT_MS = (\d+) and return it under the key "timeout_ms"$'
)
TODO_RENAME = H + " TODO(migration): rename handle to dispatch; the body stays as it is"
TODO_RETIRE = (
    H + " TODO(migration): this adapter is retired: add DEPRECATED = True and make handle raise NotImplementedError"
)


def expected_template(name, todo):
    return [
        f'"""Transport adapter {name}."""',
        todo,
        "",
        "VERSION = 1",
        "",
        "",
        "def handle(payload):",
        f'    return {{"adapter": "{name}", "version": VERSION, "payload": payload}}',
        "",
    ]


def migrate(path):
    name = path.stem
    lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").split("\n")
    todo = lines[1]
    ret = lines[7]
    if todo == TODO_BUMP:
        out = [lines[0], "", "VERSION = 2", "", "", lines[6], ret, ""]
        kind = "bump"
    elif m := TODO_TIMEOUT.match(todo):
        ms = m.group(1)
        new_ret = ret[:-1] + ', "timeout_ms": TIMEOUT_MS}'
        out = [lines[0], "", "VERSION = 1", f"TIMEOUT_MS = {ms}", "", "", lines[6], new_ret, ""]
        kind = "timeout"
    elif todo == TODO_RENAME:
        out = [lines[0], "", "VERSION = 1", "", "", "def dispatch(payload):", ret, ""]
        kind = "rename"
    elif todo == TODO_RETIRE:
        out = [lines[0], "", "VERSION = 1", "DEPRECATED = True", "", "", lines[6], "    raise NotImplementedError", ""]
        kind = "retire"
    else:
        raise SystemExit(f"{path}: unrecognised TODO: {todo!r}")
    path.write_text("\n".join(out), encoding="utf-8")
    return kind


paths = sorted(ADAPTERS.glob("a[0-9][0-9].py"))
if len(paths) != 96:
    raise SystemExit(f"expected 96 adapters, found {len(paths)}")
# Validate everything first so a bad file aborts before any write.
for p in paths:
    lines = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").split("\n")
    if lines != expected_template(p.stem, lines[1]):
        raise SystemExit(f"{p}: does not match the expected template, aborting before any write")
kinds = {}
for p in paths:
    k = migrate(p)
    kinds[k] = kinds.get(k, 0) + 1
print("migrated:", kinds)
PYEOF
